title: Flockdeck transcript line, format version 2
description: One line of a Flockdeck transcript (JSON Lines), made from the conversation the agent stored, whether recorded as it went on or exported afterwards. This file is the definition of the format: a line is valid if it validates here, and a line with a field not named for its type is not one Flockdeck writes. A field is either always present for its line type or absent for the reason its description gives. No field is ever null, an empty string standing for unknown, or a zero standing for unknown. docs/recording-format.md explains the rest.

seq.description: Line number within the file, from 1, with no gaps. Always written.

time.description: When the event happened, as the agent's own record has it (stored by the agent): RFC 3339, UTC, up to nanosecond precision. It never goes back from one line to the next: an entry whose stored time is missing, unreadable or earlier than the entry before it is given that entry's time (derived by Flockdeck). Always written.

session.description: The transcript's id: the time of the first event as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ, a hyphen, and the first eight characters of the conversation id (derived by Flockdeck). It is the file's name without .jsonl where Flockdeck named it. Always written.

conversation.description: The agent's own id of the conversation the transcript is of (stored by the agent). A transcript is of one conversation, so this is the same on every line of a file; a new one starts after /clear and has a file of its own. Always written.

agent.description: The id of the agent (claude, ...) as `flockdeck agents` lists it (known to Flockdeck). Always written.

project.description: The project's name: the last element of the first directory the stored conversation records (derived by Flockdeck from stored data). Absent only when the stored conversation records no directory at all.

gitBranch.description: The git branch the stored entry behind the line records (stored by the agent), redacted and cut at 8 KiB. Written on every line type: recording_started carries the first event's, recording_stopped the last event's, recording_truncated that of the event that did not fit, and conversation_title that of the entry before it, since a stored title has none of its own. Absent only where that entry records none.

cwd.description: The working directory the stored entry behind the line records (stored by the agent), as a full path, which usually holds the user's account name; redacted and cut at 8 KiB. Written on the same lines as gitBranch, and absent for the same reason.

agentVersion.description: The agent's own version that wrote the stored entry behind the line (stored by the agent; for Claude Code the entry's version). Written on the same lines as gitBranch, and absent for the same reason.

type.description: The line type. Always written. Each type's own fields are in the allOf below.

redacted.description: Present, and true, when anything in the line was replaced by redaction or withheld as the contents of a secret file (derived by Flockdeck). Absent means nothing was.

clipped.description: Present when a field was cut: for each field cut, its length in bytes before cutting (derived by Flockdeck). Absent means nothing was.

model.description: The model that produced the turn (stored by the agent; for Claude Code the entry's message.model). Written on assistant_message and tool_call lines only, because only those are produced by a model: a user_prompt is typed by the person, a tool_result is made by a tool, and the other lines are Flockdeck's or the agent's own. Absent on an assistant_message or tool_call whose stored entry names no model or only a placeholder such as <synthetic>.

usage.description: Tokens a model reply used (stored by the agent), on the first assistant_message or tool_call line of each reply only, so that adding usage up over a transcript counts every reply once: Claude Code repeats a reply's usage on each of the reply's entries, and Flockdeck takes it from the first entry that gives a line. Absent on the reply's other lines, and on a reply whose stored entries give no usage. Each of its four counts is written only if the stored entry gives it, so a missing key means unknown, never 0.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens that were not cached (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored usage has no such count.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored usage has no such count.

cacheCreationInputTokens.description: Input tokens written to the cache (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored usage has no such count.

cacheReadInputTokens.description: Input tokens read from the cache (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored usage has no such count.

stopReason.description: Why a model reply ended, in the agent's own word (stored by the agent; for Claude Code end_turn, tool_use, max_tokens, and so on, not a closed set, so consumers must accept others). Once per reply, on the first assistant_message or tool_call line whose stored entry gives one, which is not always the line that has the usage. Absent on the reply's other lines, and on a reply whose stored entries all have none.

tool.description: The tool's name (stored by the agent).

toolUseId.description: The agent's id of the call (stored by the agent), which pairs a tool_call with its tool_result. Absent only where the stored block gives none.

text.description: Fixed text. The first line of every file, at the time of the conversation's first event.
Fixed text. The last line of a file that was ended deliberately, at the time of the last event.
What happened, in words, with the cap in MiB. The last line of a file that reached the size cap, in place of recording_stopped.
What the person typed (stored by the agent), redacted and cut at 32 KiB.
The words the agent said (stored by the agent), redacted and cut at 32 KiB.

input.description: The tool's input as the agent gave it (stored by the agent): any JSON value, usually an object, each string in it redacted and cut at 8 KiB. Absent only where the stored call has no input.

tool.description: The name of the call this answers (derived by Flockdeck from the stored call with the same id). Absent only when that call is not in the transcript.

output.description: The text the agent was shown (stored by the agent), redacted and cut at 8 KiB; for a failure, the error. Absent where the tool returned no text. The tool's own structured result is not used.

isError.description: Whether the tool failed (stored by the agent). Written on every tool_result, true or false, so absence never has to be read as false.

interrupted.description: Whether it failed because the user stopped it. Derived by Flockdeck from the stored error text, which says so, so true only with isError true. Written on every tool_result, true or false.

title.description: The conversation's title (stored by the agent), redacted and cut at 8 KiB. Written when a title first appears and whenever it changes, never for a repeat.

trigger.description: What started the compaction, in the agent's word (stored by the agent): auto or manual. Absent where the stored entry records none.

tokensBefore.description: The conversation's size in tokens before it was summarised (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored entry records none.

tokensAfter.description: Its size in tokens after (stored by the agent). Absent where the stored entry records none.
